description.value: Angelina Bakery Broadway is a Sicilian-style Italian bakery at 1675 Broadway. Tony Park grew up Sicilian, came to New York with Nonna Anna's recipes, and opened Angelina Bakery in Times Square in 2018. The bakery promotes Bomboloni Baked Daily, a good breakfast treat.
